summary: Full **Assistència** per event (Fase 3): `GET /api/v1/events/{id}/attendance` (own row for `member`, full roster for `staff`+), `PUT /api/v1/events/{id}/attendance/me` (`yes`/`no`/`maybe` while `attendanceOpen && before start`), `PUT /api/v1/events/{id}/attendance/{userId}` (`technical`/`board`/`admin` roll-call `attended`/`absent`), live `Event.attendanceSummary` sync, and integrated UI inside `EventDetailScreen`. **Server + web (wasmJs)**.
overview:
Fase 3 slice enabling members to RSVP to open rehearsals/performances and enabling technical/board staff to take attendance after the event.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §4.4, §5.12, §6.7 (asistencia), §7.4 (Calendari detail integration) · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-schema-v02` (`attendance` with `UNIQUE(event_id, user_id)` and `comment` ≤ 200 chars).
- `platform-core-contract` (`Attendance`, `AttendanceStatus`, `AttendanceSummary`).
- `platform-server-auth`, `spec-03-calendar` (`EventDetailScreen` attendance slot + `Event.attendanceSummary`), `spec-05-members`, `platform-openapi-deploy`.

**Key business & visibility rules (§5.12 & §6.7)**
- **Self RSVP (`PUT /api/v1/events/{id}/attendance/me`):** allowed for any authenticated role (`member`+) with body `{status, comment?}`:
  - `status` MUST be one of `yes`, `no`, `maybe` (`422 validation_failed` if `attended`/`absent`).
  - Requires `event.attendanceOpen == true` (`422 validation_failed` otherwise).
  - Requires event has **not started yet**: for timed events `now < event.date`; for `allDay` events `now < startOfNextDay(event.date in Europe/Madrid)` (members can still RSVP on the day of an all-day event until end of day, or before `event.date` if timed — exact check documented in `AttendanceService`).
  - Server sets `answeredAt = Clock.System.now()` (read-only) and upserts `(eventId, currentUserId)`.
- **Staff attendance roll-call (`PUT /api/v1/events/{id}/attendance/{userId}`):** allowed for **`technical`, `board`, `admin`** (`403` for `member`) with body `{status, comment?}`:
  - Validates `userId` exists and is not `deleted` (`404`/`422`).
  - Allows setting `attended` or `absent` (and correcting RSVP `yes`/`no`/`maybe` if needed by staff, e.g. member confirmed via WhatsApp).
  - Upserts `(eventId, userId)` preserving original `answeredAt` if already set or stamping `now()`.
- **Listing (`GET /api/v1/events/{id}/attendance`):**
  - `member`: returns a list containing **only their own** `Attendance` row (0 or 1 item, including their own `comment`) so members never see other members' comments (`comment` visibility is `staff` per §5.12).
  - `technical`, `board`, `admin`: returns all `Attendance` rows for the event with basic member summary (`userId`, `name`, `lastNames`, `nickname`, `avatar`) + `comment`.
  - Public API: **none** (attendance is strictly private).
- **Live `Event.attendanceSummary`:** every RSVP or staff update is immediately reflected in `Event.attendanceSummary` (`{yes, no, maybe, attended, absent}`) queried by `spec-03-calendar`.

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test :app:shared:jvmTest :app:webApp:compileKotlinWasmJs` passes.
- Permission matrix verifies: `anonymous` (401), `member` (sees only own row on `GET`, can `PUT /me` with `yes`/`no`/`maybe`, gets `403` on `PUT /{userId}`), `technical`/`board`/`admin` (full list + `PUT /{userId}` with `attended`/`absent`).
- `PUT /me` rejects `attended`/`absent`, closed `attendanceOpen=false`, and already-started events with `422`.
- `EventDetailScreen` displays RSVP toggle buttons (`Hi vaig` / `No hi vaig` / `Potser` + optional comment) for all members when `attendanceOpen`, plus a staff roll-call list (`Hi va anar` / `No hi va anar`) when `attendance:write` is present.
- `OpenApiRouteSyncTest` passes.
shared_ui_policy: Attendance UI integrates as a section inside `EventDetailScreen` in `:app:shared` `commonMain`. `:app:webApp` hosts wasm only. Android/desktop/JS out of v1 scope.
out_of_scope:
- Global attendance statistics/dashboards across seasons (future phase).
- Push/email/WhatsApp reminders.
- Public attendance endpoints.
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

auth.client: Bearer JWT via `SessionManager`. All authenticated users see their RSVP widget; staff roll-call panel shown when `attendance:write` is present.
auth.server: `member`: own row on `GET`, `PUT /me` (`yes`/`no`/`maybe`). `technical`/`board`/`admin`: full list on `GET`, `PUT /me`, and `PUT /{userId}`.

components.name: Attendance.sq
components.usage: SQLDelight queries: upsert by `(event_id, user_id)`, fetch single user's row for an event, fetch full roster joined with `users` + `stored_files`, and aggregate counts by `status`.

components.name: AttendanceService
components.usage: Enforces `attendanceOpen` + start-time window (with injectable `Clock` for deterministic tests), `yes`/`no`/`maybe` restriction for `/me`, `comment` max 200 chars, staff upsert for any non-deleted user, and audience filtering on `GET`.

components.name: AttendanceRepository + AttendanceViewModel
components.usage: Manages current user's RSVP state, optional comment, staff roster list + quick `attended`/`absent` toggles, and notifies `CalendarViewModel` to refresh `attendanceSummary`.

components.name: EventAttendanceSection
components.usage: Embedded in `EventDetailScreen`: summary chips (`Hi vaig`, `Potser`, `No hi vaig`, `Hi va anar`, `No hi va anar`), member RSVP segmented buttons + comment field (disabled with explanation when closed/started), and staff roll-call list with quick `Hi va anar` / `No hi va anar` actions.

structure:
Vertical slice flow:

```text
Web /calendari/{id} (EventDetailScreen → EventAttendanceSection → AttendanceViewModel → AttendanceRepository → MuixerangaApi)
  ↕ JSON (Bearer)
Server AttendanceRoutes → AttendanceService → Attendance.sq (SQLite v0.2)
```

sections.title: RSVP time window & validation rules
sections.description: For `PUT /events/{id}/attendance/me`: verify event exists (`404`), `event.attendanceOpen == true`, `status ∈ {yes, no, maybe}`, `comment.length <= 200`, and current instant is before cutoff (`event.date` for timed events; `startOfNextDay(event.date in Europe/Madrid)` for `allDay` events).
sections.behavior: Return `422 validation_failed` with clear Valencian message when closed, past start, or invalid status. Inject `Clock` into `AttendanceService` so tests verify before/after cutoff deterministically.

sections.title: Visibility of `comment` and roster
sections.description: `member` calling `GET /events/{id}/attendance` receives only their own record (if any), never other members' rows or comments.
sections.behavior: `technical`, `board`, and `admin` receive the full list of respondents plus staff roll-call controls to mark `attended` / `absent` for any active colla member (even if the member did not RSVP beforehand).

endpoints.name: Get event attendance
endpoints.notes: `member`: own row only (0..1 items). `technical`/`board`/`admin`: full list with member summaries and `comment`.

endpoints.name: Upsert my attendance (RSVP)
endpoints.notes: Any authenticated user. `{status: yes|no|maybe, comment?}` while `attendanceOpen && before start`.

persistence: Uses SQLite v0.2 `attendance`, `events`, and `users` via `Attendance.sq`. Records are preserved on user soft-delete and anonymization (`decisiones.md`). No new migrations.
